title: Console: Cost Attribution Explorer + Adaptive Rollout Controls — Go-to-market orchestration
creator: Maya Kapoor
description:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates cross-functional work to launch two interrelated Console features: (1) Cost Attribution Explorer — a dashboard that breaks down token-level cost by route, model version, and customer segment with configurable groupings; and (2) Adaptive Rollout Controls — a UI + API surface to create staged rollouts, rollback rules, and budget-aware routing. The goal is a staged public launch with docs, release notes, in-product tips, and enablement materials for Customer Success and Sales.
acceptance_criteria: Cost Attribution Explorer is available in Console for all Hosted customers behind a feature flag
Explorer shows cost breakdowns by model, route, and dataset with export to CSV
Adaptive Rollout Controls allow creating a 3-stage rollout (canary, ramp, GA) with budget cap and automatic fallback
SDK and REST APIs for rollout rules documented and covered by integration tests
Telemetry integrated: events for rollout state changes, budget breaches, and cost-attribution queries
Release notes drafted, approved by Legal and Security, and translated into FR/DE/JP
Training deck + two 45-minute enablement sessions scheduled for Support and AE teams
GA checklist complete: monitoring alerts, SLOs validated, and incident playbook linked
tasks: PM: finalize PRD and decision log (link in artifacts)
Design: finalize Explorer mocks and mobile-responsive variants (DES-642)
Eng: instrument backend endpoints and aggregation functions (ENG-82144)
Eng: implement rollout rules UI and API (ENG-82701)
Docs: write user guide, API reference, and migration notes
Data: define telemetry schema, dashboards, and BigQuery export
Security/Legal: run privacy review and export controls check
Marketing: draft launch blog and product brief for the website
Support: create troubleshooting KB + run tabletop exercise
Enablement: build training deck and hands-on lab environment
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Internal dogfood (2 weeks): enable for Redwood internal orgs, collect feedback, and validate telemetry
Phase 1 - Beta customers (4 weeks): invite top 10 customers via Customer Success, monitor budget breaches and UX friction
Phase 2 - Public opt-in (2 weeks): expose feature in Console with "opt-in CTA" and in-product guidance
Phase 3 - Gradual GA (rolling 4 weeks): enable feature for all tenants with feature-flag ramp controlled by percent and budget thresholds
training_plan: Week 1: Internal lunch-and-learn + product walkthrough (recording available)
Week 2: Two live 45-minute sessions for Support and AE teams (Q&A + scenarios)
Hands-on lab: sandbox org with sample datasets and preconfigured rollouts
Playbook: decision tree for rollback, budget breach response, and escalation contacts
release_notes:
Draft summary for release notes and changelog:
- Introduced Cost Attribution Explorer: granular cost breakdowns by model, route, and customer group. Exportable CSV and saved views.
- Added Adaptive Rollout Controls: create staged rollouts with budget caps and automatic fallback. API & SDK support.
See full user guide and API reference in Docs.
